title: QAdaPrune: Adaptive Parameter Pruning For Training Variational Quantum Circuits
venue: QCE24 (IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering)
problem_summary: Adaptive algorithm that automatically determines a pruning threshold and prunes redundant/non-performing parameters during variational quantum circuit training, reducing gate complexity and circuit depth while addressing barren plateaus; reports pruned circuits perform comparably to unpruned ones and can sometimes improve trainability.

components.family_or_name: QAdaPrune: adaptive threshold-based parameter pruning during training
components.notes: Automatically determines its own pruning threshold rather than requiring a hand-tuned hyperparameter.

workflow_composition_notes: Pruning is applied during the classical optimization loop of a variational quantum circuit's training, dynamically removing parameters as training proceeds.
